resolved.title: 布尔类型
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Booleans[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Boolean variables only have two possible values: [b]true [/b](1) and [b]false [/b](0).
To declare a boolean variable, we use the keyword [b]bool[/b]. [code format="cpp" ][b]bool [/b]online = false;
[b]bool [/b]logged_in = true;[/code]
[note]If a Boolean value is assigned to an integer, [b]true [/b]becomes 1 and [b]false [/b]becomes 0.
If an integer value is assigned to a Boolean, 0 becomes [b]false [/b]and any value that has a non-zero value becomes [b]true[/b].[/note]

要声明一个布尔变量，我们使用关键字**bool**。

content.text_html:
Boolean variables only have two possible values: **true **(1) and **false **(0). To declare a boolean variable, we use the keyword bool.

布尔变量只有两个可能的值。真（1）和假（0）。 为了声明一个布尔变量，我们使用关键字bool。

content.text:
如果一个布尔值赋值给一个整数，**true**就变成1，**false**就变成0。

如果一个整数值赋值给一个布尔值，0会变成**false**，而任何有非零值会变成**true**。
content.text_html:
If a Boolean value is assigned to an integer, **true **becomes 1 and **false **becomes 0. If an integer value is assigned to a Boolean, 0 becomes **false **and any value that has a non-zero value becomes true.
